# Install AGI Cockpit

Choose the right package for Windows, macOS, or Linux, install AGI Cockpit, and open the first-run setup flow.

> Verified with AGI Cockpit 4.61.0 on 2026-08-27. [View the official documentation](https://agi-labo.com/en/tools/cockpit/docs/getting-started)

This guide installs the AGI Cockpit package for your operating system and takes you to the first-run setup flow.

## 1. Choose the package for your operating system

Open the [AGI Cockpit download page](https://agi-labo.com/en/tools/cockpit) and choose the package for your operating system.

| OS | Package | Architecture |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | Microsoft Store | x64 / arm64 |
| macOS | `.dmg` | Apple Silicon |
| Linux | AppImage / `.deb` | x64 / arm64 |

## 2. Install AGI Cockpit

### Windows

Open AGI Cockpit in Microsoft Store and select **Install**. When installation finishes, launch it from the Start menu or Store.

### macOS

Open the `.dmg`, move AGI Cockpit to Applications, then launch AGI Cockpit from Applications.

### Linux

Make the AppImage executable and launch it, or install the `.deb` with your package installer and launch AGI Cockpit from the app list.

## 3. Confirm the first launch

When there are no existing tasks, AGI Cockpit opens the first-run setup flow. Installation is complete when the app introduction appears.

Continue with [Initial setup](https://agi-labo.com/en/tools/cockpit/docs/initial-setup) to prepare an agent and the Cockpit integration.
